name: Virgin Hotels New Orleans
positioning: Lifestyle hotel in the Warehouse District of New Orleans with a rooftop pool and two-chamber rooms
best_for: Couples and groups who want a lively downtown base with a rooftop pool

facts.text: The hotel is located in the Warehouse District of New Orleans.
In the Warehouse District, restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques and BBQ joints occupy converted brick warehouses, and museums and art galleries dot the streets.
The French Quarter and the Garden District are minutes away by car.
The hotel hosts live music events and entertainment.
In-room SMEG fridges are stocked at street prices.
Wi-Fi is free, with no hidden charges.
The Virgin Hotels App lets guests order room service, adjust the temperature, control the lights and TV, or access their room.
The hotel is ADA accessible, with rooms featuring roll-in showers, tubs with grab bars, wider entrances and lowered countertops.
Commons Club, the restaurant, offers a fresh perspective on classic New Orleans recipes.
Funny Library is the hotel's coffee shop, serving pastries, brews, juices and nibbles.
Dreamboat is an intimate venue for weddings, receptions and meetings.

highlights.text: A rooftop pool with views across the city.
Rooms use a two-chamber design, with discreet partitions separating the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.
Suites offer views of the French Quarter from the balcony.
Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with flattering lights.
Dogs of all sizes and breeds are welcome.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the Warehouse District, not the French Quarter; the French Quarter is minutes away by car.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy area with potential street noise.
